decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The rear wing specification has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber Team changed the rear wing assembly of Car 24 under Parc Ferme with the approval of the Technical Delegate in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. However, the assembly is of a different specification, which is a breach of Article 40.9 and Car 24 is required to start the Race from pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 24 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber
